## Executive Summary

Modliq is a manufacturing intelligence product by Qeltrava AI, built in Tamil Nadu, India. It connects data ingestion, dataset health scoring, process optimization, Quality Studio, OEE operations, supplier risk, lean improvement, AI-assisted documentation, and buyer-ready Quality Passports.

Modliq helps manufacturers turn production data into better process decisions, validated quality, operations insight, and buyer-ready Quality Passports.

---

## Core Capabilities & Feature Breakdown

### 1. Data Ingestion & Profiling
- Universal File Ingestion: Drag-and-drop support for CSV and Excel files.
- Document Extraction: Automated table extraction from PDF and Word reference documents.
- Direct Database Connectors: Secure, read-only connectors for Supabase, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
- Automated Column Profiling: Detection of numeric process variables, quality targets, timestamps, and categorical metadata.

### 2. Dataset Health & Setup Wizard
- Health Score (0–100): Evaluates missing value density, extreme outliers, duplicate records, and target leakage risks.
- Target Leakage Protection: Identifies parameters recorded after quality inspection to prevent false ML optimization signals.
- Review & Confirm Setup: Guided step-by-step confirmation of process constraints, min/max boundaries, and target direction.

### 3. Machine Learning Process Optimization
- Surrogate ML Models: Trains Random Forest and Gradient Boosting regressors on historical batch data.
- Feature Importance & Range Bounds: Identifies top influential parameters and calculates safe trial setpoint windows.
- Financial ROI Gain Estimator: Projects monthly financial returns from yield recovery and scrap reduction.

### 4. Quality Studio & Statistical Process Control (SPC)
- Deterministic SPC Mathematics: Calculates Individuals & Moving Range (I-MR) control charts with upper/lower control limits (UCL/LCL).
- Capability Study Math (Cp & Cpk): Computes process capability indexes against upper and lower specification limits (USL/LSL).
- AQL Acceptance Sampling: ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 sampling plan calculator for incoming lot inspection.
- CAPA & 8D Generation: AI-assisted drafting of Corrective and Preventive Action plans based on root cause evidence.

### 5. Operations, Supply Chain & Lean Intelligence
- OEE Mathematics: Real-time calculation of Availability × Performance × Quality metrics.
- Downtime Pareto Analysis: Categorization of equipment downtime reasons and machine bottlenecks.
- Supplier Lot Traceability: Correlation of raw material vendor lots with finished goods defect rates and risk scores.
- Lean Toolkit: Waste tracker (7 Wastes), Kaizen action board, 5S audit checklist, and Takt time calculator.

### 6. Quality Passport (Flagship Output)
- Buyer-Ready Reports: Comprehensive PDF/Markdown export bringing together health scores, Cpk capability, optimization evidence, lot traceability, and CAPA logs into a single verifiable certificate.
- Secure Share Tokens: Read-only external link sharing for OEM buyers and auditors.

---

## Target Industries & Regional Relevance

Modliq is engineered in Tamil Nadu, India — one of South Asia's leading industrial manufacturing hubs. It serves:
- Specialty Chemicals & Polymers: Batch yield optimization, raw material variance, and 7-batch trial SOPs.
- Food Processing & Beverages: Moisture tracking, defect rates, supplier lot risk, and export Quality Passports.
- Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals: Assay, pH, compression force limits, Cpk capability, and CAPA evidence.
- Automotive Components & Machining: Rejection rate reduction, Cpk capability, and OEM audit readiness.
- Textiles & Apparel: Dyeing consistency, liquor ratios, rework rates, and fabric finishing stability.
- Plastics & Packaging: Extrusion scrap reduction, barrel temperatures, cycle times, and OEE optimization.
- Biomanufacturing: Fermentation yield, dissolved oxygen control, and batch release proof.
- Precision Engineering: Dimensional tolerance tracking, I-MR control limits, and zero-defect proof.

---

## Safety, Compliance & Governance Disclaimer

Modliq provides decision-support recommendations based on user-provided data. It does not replace qualified process engineers or certified quality managers. Modliq does not guarantee specific financial outcomes, buyer approval, or regulatory compliance. All setpoint changes should be validated through controlled trials and responsible engineering oversight.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: What is Modliq?
A: Modliq is a manufacturing intelligence product by Qeltrava AI, built in Tamil Nadu, India. It connects data ingestion, health scoring, process optimization, Quality Studio, operations, supplier risk, and buyer-ready Quality Passports.

Q: How does Modliq differ from BI tools like PowerBI or Tableau?
A: BI tools display historical charts. Modliq calculates deterministic SPC math (Cpk, I-MR), trains ML surrogate models to recommend process setpoints, and generates buyer-ready Quality Passports.

Q: How does Modliq pricing work?
A: Modliq offers a Free Launch Pilot for selected companies, a 30-day Paid Pilot (₹99,000), Pro Plant subscriptions (₹49,000/month), and Custom Enterprise plans.
